primitiveBudget: one generated compound SVG skin, six negative apertures, four perimeter exits, remote split openings, and four liftable topology cuts
commitThreshold: escape from one interior aperture to the rim, then release
memoryRule: an interior cut stays geometry-neutral until it escapes; the source aperture remains exact while an untouched remote aperture gains split topology; four cuts persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch starts in an aperture and exits through the rim; ArrowRight twice plus Enter uses the same deterministic cut; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: filled SVG bands, chamber polygons, and route hinges -> one compound even-odd SVG skin whose apertures are the material
compositionRupture: woven field, faceted body, and open register -> one asymmetric membrane organized by negative openings and a hard perimeter
encounterRupture: ordered zone crossing, gate sweep, and hinge route -> attempt an escape from an interior opening to the outside; re-entry refuses
temporalRupture: pressure load and chamber knot -> topology memory that changes what counts as an opening elsewhere
mediumRupture: filled SVG bands, polygon chambers, and paired paths -> compound SVG path with even-odd negative space and produced secondary aperture paths
changedRule: A cut is inert inside the skin. Only an escape to the perimeter spends the event by splitting an untouched remote aperture; the touched opening remains exact.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one closed irregular SVG skin with six negative apertures. A valid escape leaves no hand scar and produces a remote split opening; four split states compound.
falsifier: Delete if an interior cut changes geometry, if re-entry commits, if the source aperture changes, if the remote split is only colour or readout, if the blind skin reads as a generic blob, or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v044 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the topology skin from v041-v043 or if escape is only explanatory prose attached to a button.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
